budget.alert.warning: {engine} has used {percent}% of its monthly acquisition allowance. The month is running hot; review cadence, group priorities, and open violations.
budget.alert.critical: {engine}'s {bucket} bucket has reached {percent}% of its share. Degrade in the fixed order: re-checks starve first, then low-priority groups stop being scheduled.
budget.alert.exhausted: {engine}'s {bucket} bucket is spent. New work in it queues with budget_exhausted; nothing is truncated or silently skipped.
budget.alert.balance: {engine}'s provider balance is below the critical threshold. Top up the provider before the route disables.
password.breached: This password appears in known breach lists; choose another.
cli.bootstrap.heading: Bootstrap complete: the rights holder is recorded and an administrator is invited.
cli.bootstrap.tokenOnce: This token is shown once, is single-use, and authorises only the setup at /auth/setup. Treat it as a secret until it is consumed.
cli.bootstrap.refused: Bootstrap refused: a rights holder already exists in this deployment.
cli.adminRecover.heading: Administrator recovery: credentials were reset and re-enrolment is required.
cli.adminRecover.noAdministrator: No administrator account with that email exists.
cli.adminRecover.notLastAdministrator: Recovery refused: another active administrator exists. Reset the credentials through the operators API instead.
mail.invitation.subject: You are invited to Patrol
mail.invitation.body:
An administrator invites you to Patrol, the enforcement tool of {rightsHolder}.

Open the link below, choose a password of at least twelve characters, and enrol your second factor:

{link}

The link is single-use and expires in twenty-four hours.
mail.reset.subject: Your Patrol credentials were reset
mail.reset.body:
An administrator reset your Patrol credentials.

Open the link below, choose a new password of at least twelve characters, and enrol your second factor again:

{link}

The link is single-use and expires in twenty-four hours.
